design.name: 跳鼠刀兵
design.brief: A small, fast desert jerboa soldier that attacks in packs: an upright anthropomorphic jerboa with huge round ears, big dark eyes, a long thin tail ending in a white tuft, very long springy hind legs with big feet (four long toes each, clearly shown), sandy-orange fur. Wears scraps of old Chinese lamellar armour (a small chest plate and one shoulder plate), a ragged crimson neck scarf, and a small bronze bell glowing white-gold fixed between its ears (weak spot). Small hands with a clearly separate thumb and four separate fingers. Mischievous, twitchy, cute but dangerous.
design.weapon: two short curved Chinese daggers, mid-leap
